미술사학.title_en: The Feminine Image of Bodhisattva in Tang Dynasty and its Identity
미술사학.abstract_en: The bodhisattva images of high Tang dynasty, now we are watching, are different from the other women images which were represented in other genres like paintings and metal work producted in those days. More specifically, the bodhissattva images seem to stand out as the neuter image rather than feminine gender. Sometimes they look even foreign than the other women images of Tang dynasty. This means that the women images in Tang dynasty represented two things, the court lady image and the foreign women image. The Chinese thought that the Buddhism was a foreign religion ever since it has been transmitted to China. It is natural for them to think that if there had been a real model to make a bodhisattva image in Tang dynasty, it would have been more of a foreign woman than a Chinese woman. Neuter gender features represented on bodhisattva images are concerned with the same representational tendency in Indian sculpture during post Gupta and Pala period. On the other hand, it can be explained as a certain metaphor which reflected the status of women after Wu Zetian(巫則天) period in Tang dynasty. This contrasts well with the Buddha images like Sakyamuni which were created in the image of male gender. The Buddha images in Tang seems to strongly show their dignity by male or masculine feature. Though bodhisattvas have literally the identity of man in Buddhism as we know, its sexual identity slightly changed to that of woman at some point in high Tang period. The precious rain canon, Baoyu-jing(寶雨經) in which a man would become Maitreya(彌勒) after his rebirth in the body of woman, affected such changes. And the tendency to prefer girls to boys of the people in Tang China was also influenced. Even if one cannot find the feminine consciousness in the sociological meaning from the bodhisattva images of Tang, no one can deny that they reflected an advanced opinion about the attaining Buddhahood of women.

미술사학.title_kr: 시각문화연구와 미술사의 쟁점들 시각성과 이미지의 문제를 중심으로
미술사학.title_en: Issues in Visual Culture Studies and Art History
미술사학.abstract_en:
This paper attempts to map out the main issues concerning visual culture studies. Visual culture studies recently emerged as a nascent academic formation that offers new conceptual tools and ideas highlighting and exploring fields of vision lodged in our everyday life. The critical issues of visual culture are mainly twofold. One revolves around visuality as a discursive pattern; it considers ways in which different discourses of visuality, such acts of seeing, the history of visual apparatus, and the seeing subjects, etc., negotiate one another. 
The other is about image, the object of beholding. In an effort to dispute the traditional bias held by art historians for 'established' artworks or their selected imagesstead of artworks or the images in the artworks, that traditional art history takes as the material for study, visual culture scholars challenge the distinction between images of non-art and art. For example, visuial culture studies compare images in 20th-century advertisements and magazines with that of Renaissance paintings. This kind of ahistorical treatment of images from different periods and contexts is still criticized by many art historians and theorists. While jarring from the older disciplines across many issues and methodologies, visual culture studies continue to venture into the neglected dimensions of visual experience and interpret the visual fields of our everyday life. This paper will explore the scope of discourses that visual culture studies produced, and delve into the intersections of visual culture studies and art history.

미술사학.title_kr: 미술사와 교재 : 불교조각사와 교재, 「불교조각사와 교재」에 대한 질의, 정우택선생님의 질의에 대한 답변
미술사학.title_en: Textbooks for Courses on Buddhist Sculpture
미술사학.abstract_en: This paper explores what ideal textbooks for courses on Buddhist sculpture should aim to convey and in what manner they should be written. Textbooks for Buddhist sculpture courses at various levels should be able to ask or answer the following questions: (1) What form does an image take and how can it be effectively described in right words? (2) What is the identity of an image and what meaning was it intended to convey? (3) In what technical methods was it created? (4) In what space was it installed and in what ritual context was it used? (5) How did a group of images that share affinities in form, subject or function change in time? (6) In what manner did an image or a group of images relate to other aspects of contemporaneous Buddhist culture? (7) In what manner did an image or a group or images relate to historic or social aspects? (8) What was the place of a Buddhist image in the visual art tradition of a particular region? (9) What is the significance of a Buddhist image in the universal tradition of sculptural art? (10) How were various regional traditions of Buddhist art interrelated? (11) What kind of ideas underlay the creation or worship of an image in Buddhism? (12) How does a traditional Buddhist image relate to a contemporary visual practice? An examination of textbooks on Buddhist sculpture currently available or widely used in the Korean academia reveals that the majority of them fall far short of achieving the goals stated above. Some of them have particularly notable problems in inadequate visual analysis and careless use of language. This is inevitably related to the current state of the Buddhist art scholarship in Korea. Efforts for meticulous crafting of details in writing and visual analysis as well as attempting of innovative approaches will be essential for the creation of readable and inspiring textbooks for a new generation.

미술사학.title_kr: 미술사와 교재 : 현대미술사 교재의 다양화를 위한 대안적 모색, 「현대미술사 교재의 다양화를 위한 대안적 모색」에 대한 질의, 강태희 선생님의 질의에 대한 답변
미술사학.title_en: Rethinking the Modern Art History Survey Text for Korean Undergraduates
미술사학.abstract_en:
The purpose of this article is twofold. First, it examines the modern art history survey textbooks currently being used for art survey courses in Korean colleges. Secondly, it suggests some alternative ideas and methodologies to envision and rewrite the modern art survey text in order to provide a more comprehensive overview of modern art for Korean undergraduate students.
More than two decades have passed since modern art survey courses were first included in Korean college curricula. But almost all the modern art texts being utilized in classrooms represent European and American art, with a focus on its white male masters and their masterpieces, while paying little or no attention to the others from the rest of the world. This situation owes much to the fact that these texts are mostly direct translations of Western texts written mainly from a Western-centered point of view.
Most instructors in the academic field of art history prefer utilizing their own methods, lecture notes and visual images to any particular textbook. While this approach has some merit, many undergraduates express difficulties in approaching modern art without a textbook. New survey texts suitable for Korean students need to be developed. These texts should deal with not only the art of the West, but also that of the East, in particular, of Korea and its neighboring countries. In this era of globalization and glocalization, there should also be some introduction to diverse methodologies and perspectives including gender, race, and less-represented arts, artists, geographies, and culture.

미술사학.title_kr: 미술사와 교재 : 한국근대미술사와 교재, 「한국근대미술사와 교재」에 대한 질의, 김홍남 선생님의 질의에 대한 답변
미술사학.title_en: Modern Korean Art History and Textbooks
미술사학.abstract_en:
A new media age has arisen in response to the incredible developments in high-tech electronic media, and it is fundamentally changing the ways in which knowledge and information are aquired. All knowledge is in the process of being converted into either electronic or video media, after which it will be stored in a computer network that anyone can access and use, and that connects the entire world. In the future, the production of knowledge will also be governed by the choices of consumers. 
In schools, the site of education, textbooks, the official instrument for the transmission of knowledge and information, are also being reevaluated, and it is thought that they must be redeveloped in order to meet the demands of this new media age. In particular, when considering the methods of acquiring and recognizing knowledge and information of a new generation of learners who find greater interest and stimulation in electronic and video media, the development of hyper-texts, or hyper-media textbook formats, and multimedia reorganization is urgent. 
Art history, which uses visual materials, has certain relative advantages over other fields in the new media or video age, but the debates on textbook development that accompany the changes this age brings are still in an incomplete state. This paper, prior to actual discussions of texbook development, explored the implementation of new content, which is linked to the research directions and results of academia. Among those areas explored, as one part of the search for new content concerning the narrative of modern Korean art history, it critically examined the junior high and high school text books, which have been in use since 2001 and 2002, respectively, as well as the contents of those general introductions that are used as textbooks for undergraduate and graduate students.

미술사학.title_kr: 1950-1960년대 한국의 용접 조각
미술사학.title_en: Korean Welded Sculpture in 1950s-60s
미술사학.abstract_en:
Begun by Pablo Picasso and Julio Gonzalez in France in the late 1920s, welded sculpture has been favored by artists who seek to escape the traditional nation of sculpture as a 'solid mass'. In the postwar period, the approach was deemed especially suitable for expressing psychological pains and anxieties, and the widely spread in Europe, the United States, and Asian countries such as Korea and Japan. In the radically transformed social situations in the wake of the Korean War, welded sculpture attracted certain Korean artists who sought new directions in art.
	In this paper, I look at how welded sculpture was introduced from the west to Japan and Korea, and went through subsequent transformations. Especially, I map out how Korean welded sculpture developed, and what similarities and differences it came to have vis-à-vis its Japanese counterpart. I argue, specially through the examples of Tatehata Kakuzo, Horiuzi Masakaz, Song Young-Soo, Park Jong-Bae, Park Soek-Won and Oh Jong-Uk, that Japanese sculptors were interested in innovative possibilities the welded sculpture offered, while Korean artists were more drawn to its expressive capacity. I hope to clarify how this particular methodology played an important role in the shaping of the overall topography of postwar Korean art, and in the larger context of shifting structure of society. I try to also show how Koreans artists found in welded sculpture apt means and medium to reflect and inject their own artistic identities.

미술사학.title_kr: 미술사 교육에 있어서 재료와 제작기법
미술사학.title_en: Education of the Material and the Production Technique in Art History
미술사학.abstract_en:
The education of the material and the production techniques of works of art is the fundamental of stylistic analysis in art history. At the same time it gives a clue that leads to the restoration of traditional technique as well as the correct authentication of the works. 
Stressing the education of materials and techniques in art history, the priority methods of education may be presented as follows.
First, the special textbooks for the materials and techniques and the audio&video aides(VTR, CD, DVD, etc) have to be more properly and actively applied in class.
Second, the field survey in museums and galleries or workshops should be focused on to let the students experience the real material and the production techniques.
Third, we have to reform progressively the curriculum in the department of art history to teach the material and the technique of works of art intensively and vividly.
Fourth, the craftsmen with special skill in traditional materials and techniques should be more often invited as a lecturer.
Fifth, the lectures had better use the scientific methods and the data of conservation science of cultural properties to teach the materials and techniques in class.
Finally, the researchers should be trained in the department of art history, who major in the materials and the production techniques of works of art and can lecture them later.

미술사학.title_kr: 답사와 미술사 교육
미술사학.title_en: Field Investigation and Education of Art History
미술사학.abstract_en:
The curriculum of art history department in Korean Universities has theory of art history and actual training course which are focusing on oriental art history, western art history, and Korean art history, and field investigation which is focusing on the ground learning. Field investigation must be a valuable opportunity for the students who would like to major in art history in the future.
 However, field investigation which is managed by art history department tends to be carried out a superficial annual event and causes some problems which are relating to participation rate, personnel organization, issue of a collection of materials, passive attitude in participation of students in spite of its educational effect and significance in the field investigation of cultural heritages. Futhermore, in planning and management of field Investigation, the present investigation shows that it is short of some aspects to maximize educational effects.
 This paper is aimed at suggesting a few alternatives for the problem in field investigation of undergraduate and graduate school which I mentioned above. Moreover, it indicates that 'Field Investigation and Education of Art History' has a significance in both aspects in deepening cognition of art history and bringing about learning motivation ,and ensuring materials for art history and its education.

미술사학.title_kr: Spiritus in materiam revelatus; 생 드니 교회와 고딕 양식의 탄생에 대한 신화
미술사학.title_en:
Spiritus in materiam revelatus: 
the Myth in the Birth of Gothic at St. Denis
미술사학.abstract_en: Abbot Suger (1081 1151) renovated the apse of St. Denis from 1140 to 1144. Panofsky saw in this renovation the birth of the Gothic style, as the new ambulatory with widened windows introduced ample amount of light. He argued that this new structure reflected the Neo-Platonic theology of Pseudo-Dionysius (5th century), which regards light as the metaphor of divinity. Panofsky believed that Suger had been exposed to this idea through a translation done by John Scotus Erigena (c. 810 877). Thus, it was Suger himself who took a full control and lead in the renovation project, and the birth of Gothic should be attributed to this theologically oriented patron of art. Historians of architecture have pointed out the weakness of this theory on the basis of thorough studies of structure and engineering in the renovation. In conjunction with these recent reviews, I intend to examine Pseudo-Dionysius's original Greek text, John Scotus's Latin translation, and Suger's own record of the construction procedure, and see if the theology of light, as it had been formulated by Pseudo-Dionysius, was indeed transmitted to and visualized by Abbot Suger in the ambulatory of St. Denis. Finally I suggest to reevaluate the functional formalism of George Kubler and apply it to the question of stylistic transition from the Romanesque to Gothic at St. Denis, since his theory is well equipped to deal with the accumulative construction method of medieval architecture.

미술사학.title_en: Avalokitesvara and Dharma: the Origin of Avalokitesvara‐Bodhidharma Mural Iconography in Great Hall(Daeungbojeon) of Unmunsa Temple
미술사학.abstract_kr:
청도 운문사 대웅보전의 후불벽 뒷면에는 관음보살과 달마대사가 함께 표현된 벽화가 그려져 있다. 이 벽화는 수묵의 높고 험준한 바위산으로 화면을 구획된 화면의 향우측에 보타락가산에서 善財童子의 방문을 받고 설법하는 관음보살, 향좌측에는 선종의 初祖인 達磨大師와 2祖 慧可, 6祖 惠能에 이르는 선종의 계보를 한 화면에 표현한 것으로, 조성시기는 건물이 중건된 17세기 중반에서 다시 중수된 1773년 사이, 즉 17세기 중반~18세기 중, 후반 경으로 추정되고 있다. 그동안 이 벽화에 대해서는조선후기에 전각의 후불벽 뒷면에 관음보살을 그리던 전통에 달마대사를 더해서 그린 것, 당시 불교계를 주도하던 선종의 영향과 아울러 이 벽화가 제작된 17세기에 선종화가 유행했던 경향을 반영하여 관음보살과 달마대사를 함께 그린 것이라는 의견 등이 제시된 바 있다.
본고는 운문사에 관음보살ㆍ달마대사벽화가 배경에 대해 살펴보았다. 필자는 운문사에 다른 사찰과 달리 관음보살과 달마대사를 나란히 배치된 벽화가 그려진 것을 창건 때부터 이어져 온 운문사의 선종적 전통에서 찾아보고자 하였다. 운문사는 중국의 대표적 선종인 운문종을 종지로 하여 창건되었는데, 운문종에서는 일찍이 ‘달마대사는 관음보살의 화신'이라는 인식이 존재했으며, 이러한 인식은 운문종의 승려 雪竇 重顯의 대표적 저술인『설두송고』를 거쳐 圜悟 克勤의『벽암록』으로 이어져 왔다. 우리나라에는 고려시대 초기에 운문종이 전래되었으며, 고려시대와 조선시대에 『설두송고』와 『벽암록』이 간행됨에 따라 운문종의 ‘달마대사=관음보살’이라는 내용이 국내에도 널리 알려지게 되었고, 이것이 결국 중국 운문종을 宗旨로 하여 창건된 선종사찰 운문사의 관음보살 ㆍ달마대사벽화로 표현되었을 것으로 생각된다. 따라서 선종의 초조인 달마대사와 그의 화신인 관음보살을 나란히 배치한 운문사 대웅보전의 관음보살ㆍ달마대사벽화는, 조선후기 불전에 표현된 다른 관음보살ㆍ달마대사 벽화와 달리, 운문종과 가지산문의 전통이 꾸준하게 이어져 온 선종사찰로서의 운문사의 성격을 가장 잘 표현한 것이라 할 수 있다.
미술사학.abstract_en:
Mural paintings with Avalokitesvara and Bodhidharma are depicted behind the wall of Great Hall(Daeungbojeon) in Cheongdo Unmunsa temple. These mural paintings have Avalokitesvara, that receives a visit of eonjaedongja(Sudhana) from Potalaka and preach on the right side of the screen, which is partitioned by the high and rugged rocky mountains. On the left is expressed on one screen the Zen sector that is the 1st Zen sector, Bodhidharma (483~540), 2nd Huike (487-593), and 6th Huineng (683-713). The building dates were estimated from the mid‐17th century, when the building was rebuilt, to the 1773 rebuilt, that is, from the mid‐17th century to the mid/late‐18th century. In the meantime, these mural paintings were made by adding Bodhidharma to the tradition of painting Avalokitesvara on the back of the temple wall in the late Joseon period. It was suggested that Zen that led the Buddhist period at the time, and Avalokitesvara and Bodhidharma were drawn together to reflect the trend of Zen paintings in the 17th century when these mural paintings were produced.
In this article, Avalokitesvara‐Bodhidharma mural paintings were examined in the background of Unmunsa temple. In Unmunsa temple, unlike other temples, the author tried to find the mural paintings arranged side by side with Avalokitesvara and Bodhidharma in the Zen style tradition of Unmunsa temple which had been built since its foundation. Unmunsa temple was founded on the basis of the representative Zen of China, Yunmen Sect (Unmunjong). Early in Yunmen Sect there was a perception that 'Bodhidharma was an incarnation of Avalokitesvara'. This recognition has been linked to "Byeokamrok(The Blue Cliff Record)" of Yuanwu Keqin (1063-1135) through "Seoldusonggo"(Xuedou’s brief explication in verse of the essence of koan), a representative work of Yunmen Sect's monk Xuedou Zhongxian (980~1052). In Korea, Unmunjong was introduced in the early Goryeo period. With the publication of "Seoldusonggo" and "Byeokamrok" in the Goryeo and Joseon era, "Bodhidharma=Avalokitesvara" of Yunmen Sect became widely known in Korea. This would have been expressed as Avalokitesvara‐Bodhidharma mural paintings of Zen Buddhism in Unmunsa temple, which was eventually built as China’s Yunmen Sect as basis. Thus, the Avalokitesvara‐Bodhidharma mural paintings of Unmunsa temple’s Great Hall(Daeungbojeon), alongside Zen's 1st Patriarch Bodhidharma and his incarnation Avalokitesvara, unlike other Avalokitesvara‐Bodhidharma mural paintings expressed in the late Joseon Buddhist altar, it is the best representation of the character of Unmunsa temple as Zen Buddhism which has been consistently continuing the tradition of Yunmen Sect and Gajisanmun.

미술사학.title_kr: 불복장 의복 봉안의 의미:상원사 문수동자상의 저고리와 전설을 중심으로
미술사학.title_en: The Practice of Enshrining Clothing in Buddhist Statues:Exploring the Legend of the Traditional Korean Jacket from the Mañjuśrī Statue at Sangwonsa
미술사학.abstract_kr:
불복장의 내용물 중 일부로 공양자가 입던 의복을 봉안하는 관습은 한국 불복장의 두드러진 특징 중 하나이다. 본고에서는 상원사 문수동자상 불복장에서 발견된 두 점의 저고리를 중심으로 조선시대 후원자들이 불복장 안에 입던 의복을 봉안했던 의미를 살펴보았으며, 이 저고리중 하나와 연결지어지게 된 세조와 문수보살에 대한 전설이 만들어진 경위도 추정해 보았다. 상원사 문수동자상에서 1984년에 발견된 저고리는 붉고 누런 얼룩이 묻어 있었는데, 이 정체불명의 얼룩 때문에 발견 직후부터 오대산에서 전해지던 세조 世祖 (재위 1455~1468)의 전설과 연관지어졌다. 이 전설에 따르면 세조는 피부병을 고치기 위해 오대산에 목욕을 하러 갔는데, 문수보살이 동자로 화현하여 세조의 등을 닦아주어 병을 치료해주었다고 한다.
본고에서는 문헌사료를 검토하여 해당 저고리는 세조의 의복일 가능성이 크나, 세조의 피부병에 관한 전설은 세조 사후에 만들어진 것이라는 의견을 제시한다. 또한 바로 이 얼룩진 저고리는 세조의 전설이 남긴 흔적이 아니라, 그 반대로 세조 사후 그러한 전설을 탄생시킨 물질적 매개체(material agent)로 기능했을 가능성이 있음을 제시하였다. 어린 조카를 몰아내고 왕위에 올랐던 세조는 생전에 많은 불사를 하였으며, 백의관음화현 등 다양한 상서(祥瑞)를 적극적으로 활용하여 취약했던 자신의 정통성을 강화하는데 활용하였던 왕으로 알려져 있다. 문수보살은 동아시아에서 피부병 치료와 관련이 있는 전설이 많았던 보살이며, 1599년 문수동자상을 중수하고 중수발원문을 불상내부에 채워넣을 때 사람들이 발견하였을 얼룩진 저고리는 세조의 피부병에 대한 또 하나의 전설을 만들어내는 기폭제가 되었을 것이다. 또한 이 얼룩진 저고리는 20세기에 학자들에 의해 다시 한 번 발견되어 세조에 대한 전설을 다시 한 번 널리 알리는 물질적 매개체의 역할을 하게 된다.
앞서 언급한대로 의복을 불복장의 일부로 사용했던 것은 조선시대 불교의 두드러진 특징이다. 그러나 불복장의 근거로 사용되었던 『조상경(造像經)』의 내용에도 이러한 의복은 언급이 되지 않았기 때문에 이는 불경의 내용을 따른 관습이 아니고, 그러한 풍속이 성행하지 않았던 중국이나 인도의 의례를 따른 것으로 보이지도 않는다. 본고에서는 불복장으로 불교의 성상 안에 봉안되는 의복은 의복주인의 몸을 공양하는 의미로 넣어지는 것이라고 추정하였다. 즉, 공양자의 신체와 접촉했던 입던 옷이 공양자의 대체신체 (代替身體, substitute body)로써 불상 안에 봉안되었던 것이다. 한국에서는 뼈와 장기 등 육신을 특히 부정적으로 여기던 전통이 있었기 때문에, 불자들이 불상 안에 자신의 몸을 대신하여 의복을 봉안하는 관습이 각광을 받게 되었던 것으로 추정된다. 한국에서는 공양자의 손톱, 머리카락, 치아 등을 불상 안에 공양하지 않았음며, 불복장에 봉안되는 부처님의 오장육부도 실제장기의 형상을 모방하기 보다는 삼각형 반원형 등의 기하학적 천조각으로 오장육부를 상징적으로 만들어 넣는 방식이 선호하였다. 한국에서는 공양자의 분절된 신체(fragmented body) 대신 자신의 신체와 접촉했던 옷을 공양하였으며, 따라서 공양자의 신체를 상징하고 대체하는 의미를 가졌기 옷은 공양자의 소원을 적는 기복의 매개체로 기능하기도 하였다. 본고의 끝부분에서는 불복장으로 사용된 옷에 다라니를 ...
미술사학.abstract_en: Korean Buddhist tradition had a unique practice of enshrining used human clothing in sacred Buddhist statues. Since Korean scholars began systematically examining the inner space of Buddhist statues a few decades ago, many articles of clothing have been found from the late Goryeo and the entire Joseon period. Buddhist countries in Asia share a similar practice, enshrining various sacred objects in newly produced Buddhist statues so as to instill life into them; however, enshrining the used clothing of ordinary people was a practice unique to Korea. Until now, the clothing discovered from Buddhist statues has mainly been used to study the history of clothing and textiles, but the religious function and psychological grounds of this unique practice have received little scholarly attention. By adopting anthropological methodologies, this paper argues that human clothing was enshrined in sacred statues as a substitute for the donor’s body. In Korean culture, where fragments of human bodies were regarded as inauspicious, Buddhists did not enshrine their hair or nails in such statues. This contrasts with the practice in other Asian countries, where human body parts such as hair, teeth, nails and umbilical cords were frequently encased in Buddhist statues. Since human clothing served as a proxy for the donor’s body in Korea, used clothing that had intimate contact with the donor’s body was preferred to that which was clean or newly produced. As a stand-in for the donor’s body, it also served as a medium to convey the donor’s prayers to the Buddhist deities and thus frequently was inscribed with the donor’s wishes. While broadly exploring the meaning and function of human clothing encased in Buddhist statues, this paper also offers an in-depth analysis of the stained traditional jacket that was discovered in 1984 inside the Mañjuśrī statue (1466) at Sangwonsa on Mount Odae in Gangwon Province. Since its discovery, this jacket with strange red and yellow stains was believed to be the clothing of King Sejo (r. 1455-14680). According to a legend handed down on Mount Odae, King Sejo had traveled to Mount Odae and took a bath in a stream to cure his skin disease. A boy passing by, who was Mañjuśrī in disguise, washed the king’s body, and the disease was miraculously healed. This paper shows that the stained clothing found in the Mañjuśrī statue, whose donor was a daughter of King Sejo, is not proof of such legend but a material agent that gave rise to such legend in the Joseon period.

미술사학.title_kr: 프랑스 문화재 보호정책의 역사와 세계유산 등재 제도의 의미
미술사학.title_en: The history of the French cultural property protection policy and the meaning of the World Heritage listing system
미술사학.abstract_kr: 프랑스 사회에서 문화재 개념에 관한 논의가 본격적으로 시작된 시점은 1789년 대혁명 시기였다. 프랑스에서 문화재 보호 정책의 출발은 정치적 대립과 사상적 논쟁의 결과로서 비롯되었다. 절대왕정 체제의 종식과 새로운 공화주의 국가의 수립을 둘러싼 극심한 정치적 갈등 속에서 프랑스 지식 사회는 문화유산의 안정적인 보존과 지속적인 전승을 위한 제도적 방안을 고민하기 시작했다. 지난 역사의 흔적을 의도적으로 파괴하려는 혁명의 광기로부터 역사문화재와 예술품을 보호하고 원형 상태로 보존하려는 시도들은 프랑스 사회에서 문화재 보호정책의 수립을 가져온 주요한 동인이었다. 문화정책 전반에 있어서 국가의 역할을 강조하는 프랑스 사회에서 문화재 보존과 관리 업무의 주체는 항상 국가였다. 근대 서구 사회에서 국가 차원의 문화재 관련 제도를 제일 먼저 수립한 나라는 프랑스였으며 문화재 정책에서 가장 중요한 가치는 공공성이었다. 따라서 국가의 보호 대상이 되는 문화재의 범주를 설정하고 공공 부문에서 문화재 보존 정책을 수행해야 하는 이유와 당위성을 규정하는 것은 대혁명 시기 이후 프랑스 사회에서 매우 중요한 문제로 대두되어 왔다. 프랑스에서 문화재는 기념비성, 역사적 의미, 오래됨, 미적 가치, 정체성 그리고 공동의 기억 등의 가치들을 근거로 설정되었으며 그 범주는 순차적으로 확장되었다. 프랑스 대혁명이 발발한 이후 약 2세기에 걸쳐 수많은 논의와 보완을 걸쳐 시행되어온 역사유적 및 문화재 보호 제도는 프랑스 사회에서 그 당위성을 인정받고 있다. 문화재 보호에 관한 사회적 합의와 법제화된 제도의 시행 경험을 축적한 프랑스 정부는 유네스코와의 협력을 통해 세계유산 제도가 시행되는데 주도적인 역할을 수행했다. 2016년 기준 총 42개의 유네스코 등재 세계유산을 보유하고 있는 프랑스는 유럽에서 이탈리아의 뒤를 이어 독일과 함께 가장 많은 수의 세계유산을 보유하고 있는 국가이다. 본 논문에서는 이러한 프랑스 문화재 보호정책의 특징과 역사적 변천 과정을 조망하고 현재 프랑스 사회에서 유네스코 세계유산제도가 지닌 의미와 활용 방식에 관해 고찰해 보고자 한다.
미술사학.abstract_en:
The discussion about the concept of cultural property began in earnest in French society in the period of the Revolution of 1789. The start of the cultural property protection policy in France originated as a result of political confrontation and ideological controversy. In the extreme political conflicts surrounding the end of the absolutist regime and the establishment of a new republican state, the French society of intellectuals began to contemplate institutional measures for the stable preservation and continued transmission of cultural heritage.
Attempts to preserve historical and cultural properties and art works from the revolutionary madness of deliberately destroying the traces of history, and to preserve them in their original forms, were the major drivers of the establishment of cultural property protection policies in French society. In French society, which emphasizes the role of the state in cultural policy as a whole, the state is always in charge of the preservation and management of cultural property. In the modern western society, France was the first country to establish national cultural property system, and public concern was the most important value in cultural property policies. Therefore, defining the reason and necessity of establishing the categories of cultural assets to be protected by the state and carrying out cultural property preservation policies in the public sector have become a very important issue in the French society since the Revolution.
In France, cultural properties are based on values such as a significant monumentality(signification mémoriele), a historical value(valeur historique), antiqueness(ancienneté), an aesthetic value(valeur esthétique), an identity(identité), and collective memories(mémoires collectives) and the categories expanded sequentially. The historical remains and cultural property protection system, which has been under discussion and supplementation for about two centuries since the outbreak of the French Revolution, is well acknowledged in modern French society. The French government, which has accumulated the social consensus on the protection of cultural properties and the implementation of legislative systems, has played a leading role in the implementation of the World Heritage(Patrimoine mondial) system in cooperation with UNESCO. With a total of 42 UNESCO-listed World Heritage sites by 2016, France is the country with the largest number of world heritage sites along with Germany, followed by Italy in Europe.
In this paper, the characteristics of the French cultural property protection policy and the historical process of change will be throughly looked into, and the significance of the UNESCO World Heritage system and the ways to utilize it in France will be examined.

미술사학.title_kr: 아카데미에서 시장으로의 제도적 변화 : 인상주의의 국제적 수용과 전문 화상의 역할
미술사학.title_en: The Institutional Change form Academy to the Market : the Internatinal Acceptance of impreessioism anr the Role Played by Professional Dealers
미술사학.abstract_kr:
본 논문은 오늘날과 같은 시장중심 미술제도가 정착한 과정을 소개하는데 주 목적이 있다. 인상주의가 국제적으로 수용되기까지의 약 반세기의 기간은 르네상스 이후 지속되어왔던 아카데미 체제가 결정적으로 쇠퇴하고 화상들을 중심으로 한 시장중심의 미술제도가 새롭게 정립되는 기간이었다. 따라서 인상주의가 등장해서 수용되기까지의 과정을 추적하면서 아카데미가 쇠퇴하게 된 이유를 밝히고 아카데미가 수행했던 미술에 관한 규범의 제정, 교육, 전시와 평가, 화가의 생계 문제 등이 시장에 의해 해결되는 과정을 살펴본다. 아데미의 쇠퇴는 살롱의 과다한 성장에서 시작되었다. 살롱의 인기로 작가들의 숫자가 크게 증가하면서 아카데미는 화가들을 위한 교육시설, 충분한 전시공간과 일거리, 부상을 마련할 수 없게 되었다.
19세기 중후반에 등장하는 “기업가적인” 화상들은 미술관과 같은 고급스런 분위기의 공간에서 아카데미와 살롱의 유명한 화가들로 구성된 작가협회를 결성해서 “딜러-작가” 간의 연계를 도모했다. 1852년 설립된 경매회사 오텔 드루오(Hôtel Drouot)는 화상들의 투기와 내부거래를 통한 가격조작 등의 관행을 낳는 온상이 되기도 했고, 그 과정에서 화상들 간의 그리고 화상들과 자본가들과의 연계가 이루어졌다. 또한 경매회사에서 비평가와 역사학자들을 동원해서 작가를 홍보했던 경험을 통해 화상들이 비평가와 연계하는 “딜러-비평가 제도“가 만들어지는 단초가 되었다. 그리고 이런 화상들과 비평과의 연계를 기반으로 장기적인 안목으로 잠재적 대가를 키우는 뒤랑뤼엘(Durand-Ruel)과 같은 ”이데올로기적“ 화상의 등장이 가능했다. 그리고 인상주의는 화상들의 국제적 연계를 통해서 미국과 독일의 경제력의 도움을 받아 수용되었다.
아카데미는 작가보다 작품을 중시하는 제도였으나 장기적인 관점에서 잠재적 대가를 지원하는 “이데올로기적” 화상들에게는 당연히 특정 작품보다 작가의 작품 전체가 중요했다. 따라서 작가의 기질을 강조하는 개인전이 중시되었고, 이는 아카데미와 살롱에서의 경력을 대신할 작가의 역사를 만들어주었다. 훈련된 감식안이 없었던 신흥 부르주아계층은 작가의 명성에 의존하는 경향이 있었으며, 이러한 대중의 취향과 화상들의 경제적 이해로 점차 걸작보다 천재거장이 중시되는 관행이 정착되었다.
인상주의는 오늘날과 같은 위상을 부여받기까지는 반세기 가량의 긴 시간이 걸렸다. 유럽대륙에서 인상주의는 절충주의(juste millieu)라고 하는 일군의 화가들과 오랫동안 동일시되었다. 아카데미의 명확성과 인상주의의 거친 색채와 붓질을 혼합했던 절충주의 화가들은 유명화가들로 이들은 프랑스에서 “나쇼날(National)”이라는 분리된 살롱을 개최한 것을 시작으로 뮌헨, 비엔나, 베를린에서 분리파(Seccessionism)를 조성했다. 분리파의 국제적인 전시를 통해 프랑스 모더니즘이 본격적으로 유럽에 소개되면서 인상주의에서 후기인상주의로 이어지는 배타적인 모더니즘 계보가 확립되었고 절충주의는 사라졌다. 그러나 소수 엘리트의 분리는 결국 뛰어난 개별 작가들의 개별적인 분리로 귀결되었고, 이들은 경험있는 화상들에게 의존했다.
아카데미가 쇠퇴하고 화상이 그 역할을 대신했던 과정은 우리의 경우에도 그대로 적용되는 과정이었다. 그리고 1880년대 절충주의가 인상주의와 동일시되었던 것이 일본과 우리가 서...
미술사학.abstract_en:
This thesis has its purpose in introducing the exact process in which the current market-centered art system developed. The half century in which impressionism became widely accepted was the period in which the academy-oriented art system gave way to the new art dealer-oriented market system of today. This paper seeks to trace the course in which impressionism gained popularity and show how this phenomenon is correlated to the decline of the art academy. This paper will then show how the various functions of the academy - creation of standards for art, education, exhibition planning and adjudication, and maintenance of artists’ livelihoods - were taken up by the art market system. The initial decline of the academy was triggered by the excessive growth of the salon. As salons gained widespread popularity, the number of active artists increased, which in turn, made it difficult for the academy to provide all artists with enough education facilities, exhibition opportunities, and monetary compensation.
The entrepreneurial art dealers of the mid and late nineteenth century promoted “dealer-artist” relationships by creating an artist association composed of famous artists from the academy and the salon. The art auction company Hôtel Drouot established in 1852 triggered the practice of price manipulation through internal trading. This practice necessitated increased connection between art dealers. Furthermore, auction companies cooperated with art critics and art historians to advertise certain artists which created new “dealer-critic” relationships. This network between art dealers and art critics became the basis for “ideological” art dealers such as Durand-Ruel who raised potential master painters with long-term insight. Also, impressionism was able to become widely accepted thanks to the art dealer’s global network that included the United States’s and Germany’s economic power.
While the traditional practice by the academy was to favor artworks over artist, to the “ideological” art dealers who had to sponsor potential master artists in the long term, the artist was naturally more important than certain artworks. As a result, personal exhibitions that focused on an artist’s unique characteristics prevailed, replacing the academy’s exhibitions as channels for an artist to build a career and expose him or herself to the public. The new bourgeoise lacked an educated taste for art and tended to rely on artists’ fame as an index for measuring artistic ability. This phenomenon in conjunction with the financial interests of art dealers created a convention of favoring master artists over masterpieces.
It took half a century for impressionism to receive the high status it has today. In the European continent, impressionism was equated with juste millieu for a long time. Juste millieu artists who coupled the academy’s clarity with impressionism’s rough use of paint and color were renowned artists. They started separate salons beginning with the “National” in France and organized a separate sect called “Secessionism” in Munich, Vienna, and Berlin. Secessionism’s global exhibitions introduced French modernism to the European continent and had the effect of establishing an exclusive modernist lineage that extended from impressionism to post impressionism at the expense of juste millieu. However The divorcement of a few elites resulted in all exceptional individual artists parting to rely on experienced art dealers.
The decline of the academy and the replacement of its functions by the art dealers is a process that applied to the Korean reality as well. Also, the 1880’s practice of equating juste millieu with impressionism is the reason behind Japan’s and Korea’s adoption of juste millieu instead of impressionism in the period in which Western art was first introduced. 미술사학.title_kr: 브로드웨이에서 로열 아카데미까지 : 에드윈 어스틴 애비의 영국 미술 수용 과정 연구
미술사학.title_en: From Broadway to Royal Academy of Arts: A Study on the Accepting Process of English Art by Edwin Austin Abbey
미술사학.abstract_kr:
에드윈 어스틴 애비(Edwin Austin Abbey, 1852-1911)는 삽화, 회화, 벽화를 통해 영국의 미술 경향을 미국 미술계로 활발하게 전달한 인물이다. 애비의 보스턴 공공 도서관 벽화에 등장하는 기사는 중세 복고주의, 로열 아카데미와 라파엘전파 테마 등이 복합적으로 융합된 테마로서 영국 미술이 미국적으로 변환된 확실한 증거이다.
애비를 비롯해 휘슬러, 사전트, 프란시스 데이비스 밀레와 같은 작가들은 예술적 역량을 펼칠 곳으로 영국 도시를 선택했다. 이들이 영국 도시를 선택한 이유는 같은 앵글로 색슨 혈통 출신이라는 동질감 때문에 쉽게 유대관계를 형성할 수 있으리라는 기대감 때문이며, 언어뿐 아니라 역사 인식에 있어서도 프랑스 보다 영국을 선호했기 때문이다. 그러나 무엇보다도 이들의 영국 활동을 부추긴 바탕에는 영국 숭배 현상, 즉 앵글로매니아 증상이 자리하고 있다.
1880년대 중후반 영국 중서부의 브로드웨이(Broadway)는 애비, 사전트, 밀레를 포함해 미국 예술가들이 집단으로 거주하던 장소였다. 브로드웨이는 미술과 공예 운동과 관련된 이들에게 대안이 되었으며, 미술과 공예 운동이 사라져 간 자리는 미국 출신의 예술가, 작가들로 대체되기 시작했다. 애비는 중세 전원도시의 영감의 원천지로서 브로드웨이의 매력을 적극적으로 탐구했다. 이때부터 애비는 그의 미술에서 중요한 두 가지 요소인 셰익스피어와 중세라는 코드를 나타내기 시작했으며, 그의 작품에서 셰익스피어와 아더왕 전설과 같은 영국 문학 테마를 재현했다. 특히 애비는 1885년부터 1889년까지 런던 북서부의 브로드웨이에 거주하면서 미국에서 삽화가로 활동한 경력을 살려 문학 테마를 더욱 본격적으로 제작했다.
또한 애비의 영국 미술 수용 과정에서 로열 아카데미 역할도 주목할 필요가 있다. 애비는 1896년 로열 아카데미 준회원으로, 1898년 로열 아카데미 회원으로 선출되었다. 애비는 정신적 가치와 도덕성의 강조, 중세주의에 대한 관심, 풍부한 세부묘사와 꼼꼼한 제작 기법에서는 라파엘전파의 미술을 수용했으며, 문학 테마의 선택, 테마를 다루는 방식은 로열 아카데미로부터 수용했다.
영국 미술계에서 성공할 수 있는 잠재력을 확인한 애비는 로열 아카데미가 권장하는 문학 테마 가운데 셰익스피어 문학과 테마에 집중했다. 애비가 로열 아카데미에서 존재감을 드러내고 미술가로 성공할 수 있었던 것은 바로 복잡한 셰익스피어 문학 테마를 선택했기 때문이다. 애비가 로열 아카데미에서 존재감을 드러낸 또 다른 이유는 세세한 시기 연구와 텍스트에 기반한 역사적, 고증적 자세와 접근 방식 때문이다. 애비는 골동품과 중세, 의상, 건축 등에 관한 광범위한 지식을 가지고 있었으며, 신화, 문학, 유럽 역사에 대한 고증적 자세로 작품을 제작함으로써 역사화가로 자리매김할 수 있었다.
미국과 영국 양쪽에서 예술적 역량을 넓힌 이와 같은 독특한 애비의 경력은 영국과 미국 미술 양쪽을 반영함으로써 영국에 있는 그의 동시대인들과도 구분되며, 1880년대 영국 유학을 마치고 미국으로 건너간 미국 유학생들과도 뚜렷하게 구분된다. 본 연구는 애비의 영국 정착 과정에서 라파엘전파와 로열 아카데미 미술 수용 과정을 기술함으로써 영국 미술이 미국 미술로 전파된 보다 구체적인 경로를 파악할 수 있었다. 무엇보다도 미국 미술가들의 정착촌 브로드웨이의 형성과 애비의 영국 정착 과정을 기술함 ...
미술사학.abstract_en:
Edwin Austin Abbey (‘Abbey’, 1852-1911) is an artist who actively disseminated United Kingdom’s art trend to America throughout the form of an illustration, paintings and murals. The Knight shown in the murals of Boston Public Library represents a theme where medieval revival, Royal Academy of arts and Pre-Raphaelites are comprehensively blended, which definitely proves the fact that the United Kingdom’s Art was transformed into American Style.
Artists such as Whistler, Sargent, Francis D. Millet and Abbey handpicked cities of British Kingdom as a place to display their artistic capacity. Reason of picking Cities of United Kingdom was in expectation of establishing bonding relationships in a more easy and efficient manner between America and British Kingdom, given the identity of both of them being originated from Anglo-Saxon, and in a preference of United Kingdom rather than France considering language proficiency as well as understanding toward history. Above all, intimate ground of inciting their artistic participation in United Kingdom could be also found from their United Kingdom worship phenomenon, so called Anglomania symptom.
In middle-late 1880, Broadway located in the northwest of London was a place where American artist such as Abbey, Sargent and Millet stayed. Broadway was an alternative option for artists engaged in Arts and Craft Movement, which was stipulated into American painters, writers and illustrators. Abbey actively explored attractive merits of Broadway being a source of medieval rural cities. Abbey from that timing begun to represent two main factors i.e. Shakespeare and Medieval theme, which are importantly positioned throughout his art and begun to present English Literature theme e.g. Shakespeare and King Arthur. Stayed in Broadway from year 1885 through 1889, Abbey buckled down to produce literature theme based on his earlier experiences as illustrator in America.
It is important to take note of Royal Academy’s role shown in the course of Abbey’s embracing United Kingdom’s art into his art. Being an Associate Academician member in 1896, Abbey was elected as an Academician in 1898. Abbey accepted technical methods from Pre-Raphaelites such as spiritual value, emphasis on morality, interest toward Medievalism and rich description in precise details and handling methods from Royal Academy such as selection of literature theme, mode of producing such literature theme.
With self confidence of his successful potential, Abbey focused on Shakespearean literature themes out of multiple literatures themes recommended by Royal Academy. He sympathized on academic text, subject and ideal expression skill recommended by Royal Academy. Reason of raising sense of his existence and succeeding as an artist was due to his selecting Shakespeare’ complex literature theme as his own theme. Another reason was due to his approach based on detailed historical research and restoring artifacts search. Abbey produced the art by adopting approach of restoring literature, European history and Myths based on his immense and comprehensive knowledge on antiques, medieval, costumes, architecture, which resulted to his positioning as a historical painters.
Abbey’s expanded artistic capability and distinctive experiences in both of America and United Kingdom distinguished him from artists of contemporary as well as students worked in United Kingdom in age 1880 but returned to America afterwards. This thesis focused on the process and route to accept English Art trend by Abbey. Especially this thesis will be meaningful to identify the route to trace the process of the establishing Broadway for American artists in England.

미술사학연구.title_kr: 조선왕릉 동원이강릉의 성립 배경에 관한 연구: 광릉을 중심으로
미술사학연구.title_en: A Study on the Formation of Tongwŏn Igangnŭng in the Royal Tombs of the Chosŏn Dynasty: Focusing on Kwangnŭng
미술사학연구.abstract_kr:
본 연구는 조선왕릉 동원이강릉(同原異岡陵)이 어떠한 조건과 조정을 거쳐 성립하였는지를 광릉의 형성 과정을 통해 밝히는 데 목적이 있다. 1468년 광릉은 정희왕후의 장래 능침을 포함하지 않은 세조의 단릉으로 완결되었다. 약 15년 뒤인 1483년 정희왕후의 능침은 세조릉에서 약 190m 떨어진 북동쪽 별도 구릉에 조성되었다.
이는 이미 완결된 세조릉을 보존하면서 왕후를 같은 능역에 모시기 위한 선택으로, 서로 다른 구릉이면서도 같은골 안에 포괄되는 지형과 기존 능제를 그대로 적용하기 어려웠던 세조릉의 선행완결과 정희왕후릉의 후장이그 시간적 조건이 되었다. 흉년과 공역 부담도 두 능 사이에 공동 정자각을 마련하도록 촉진하였다. 조정은 ‘비록혈은 다르지만 같은 골 안’에 있다는 판단과 ‘부인은 남편을 따른다’는 원칙에 따라 두 능침에 하나의 능호를 적용하였다. 그러나 세조는 길례, 정희왕후는 흉례의 대상이었으므로 삼년상 기간에는 제향을 구분하고 이후 합제로전환하였다. 이 운영 방식은 1499년 창릉의 제향 논의에서 ‘광릉 구례’로 인용되었다. 따라서 광릉에서 동원이강릉이 성립한 것은 완결된 세조릉의 보존, 정희왕후의 후장, 같은 골 안의 서로 다른 두 구릉, 기존 능제 적용의제약, 공역 부담, 능호 · 정자각 · 제향의 단계적 조정이 복합적으로 작용한 결과이다.
미술사학연구.abstract_en: This study investigates the conditions and adjustments through which Tongwŏn Igangnŭng emerged in the royal tombs of the Chosŏn dynasty by reconstructing the formation of Kwangnŭng. Kwangnŭng was completed in 1468 as the single tomb of King Sejo, without a burial site planned for Queen Chŏnghŭi. Approximately fifteen years later, in 1483, the queen’s tomb was constructed on a separate hill to the northeast, about 190 meters from the king’s mound. This choice preserved the completed tomb of King Sejo while placing the queen within the same royal tomb precinct. The spatial conditions for this arrangement were provided, in which two distinct hills were encompassed within the same valley, while the temporal conditions arose from the prior completion of King Sejo’s tomb and the later burial of Queen Chŏnghŭi, which made earlier arrangements for royal couples difficult to apply without modification. Famine and the burden of construction further encouraged the establishment of a shared Chŏngjagak between the two tombs. The court placed both tombs under the single name Kwangnŭng on the grounds that, although they occupied different burial sites, they lay within the same valley, and on the principle that a wife follows her husband. A common tomb name and a shared ritual building, however, did not immediately unify the rites. King Sejo was already the object of auspicious rites, whereas Queen Chŏnghŭi remained subject to mourning rites. Their observances were therefore kept separate during the mourning period and combined only afterward. In 1499, this operational arrangement was cited in discussions of rites at Ch’angnŭng as the “old precedent of Kwangnŭng,” showing that the response devised at Kwangnŭng had become an applicable royal precedent. The formation of Tongwŏn Igangnŭng at Kwangnŭng thus resulted from the combined operation of six factors: the preservation of King Sejo’s completed tomb; the later burial of Queen Chŏnghŭi; two separate hills within the same valley; the difficulty of applying existing burial arrangements; the burden of construction; and the successive coordination of the tomb name, Chŏngjagak, and ritual order.

미술사학연구.title_kr: 조선 후기 김룡사 고승 진영의 봉안과 제작: 문중 기제(忌祭)와 사불산화파
미술사학연구.title_en: The Enshrinement and Production of Late Chosŏn Eminent Monk Portraits(chinyŏng) at Kimnyongsa Temple: Monastic Clan Memorial Rites(kije) and the Sabulsan Painting School(sabulsan hwap'a)
미술사학연구.abstract_kr:
본 논문은 김룡사를 중심으로 조선 후기 고승 진영의 조성과 승려 문중의 역할을 살펴보고 진영의 제작자와제작 시기에 따른 특징을 고찰했다. 조선 후기 승려들은 법맥 기반의 승려 문중을 중심으로 진영 제작과 기제를주도했다. 이러한 경향이 잘 드러나는 김룡사에는 18세기 이후 환성계 승려 문중이 양진암, 대성암, 화장암에세거하면서 암자의 운영과 함께 기제를 담당했다. 게다가 세 암자에 전하는 제사 관련 기록, 영당, 진영은 암자가사찰 운영의 중심지였음을 보여준다. 김룡사 진영은 사불산화파인 신겸, 수연, 자우, 응상이 환성계 승려 문중으로서 제작을 맡았음이 확인된다. 특히 신겸은 독자적인 화풍을 구사해 동시기 다른 진영과 차별성을 보였다.
이는 19세기 경상도에서 유행한 정형화된 화풍의 진영이 김룡사에는 신겸 활동 이후부터 나타나는 점을 통해서도 확인할 수 있었다. 즉, 김룡사 진영은 신겸 활동 이후를 기점으로 다른 사찰과 유사해지는 경향을 보인다.
미술사학연구.abstract_en:
This article examines the production of eminent chinyŏng(monks portraits) and the role of sŭngnyŏ munjung(monastic clan) during the late Joseon Dynasty, focusing on Kimnyongsa Temple and analyzing stylistic characteristics by painter and period. During this era, sŭngnyŏ munjung based on dharma lineages led portrait production and kije(memorial rites). This trend is clearly evident at Kimnyongsa Temple, where the hwansŏnggye sŭngnyŏ munjung settled in three hermitages—Yangjin'am, Taesŏng'am and Hwajang'am—from the 18th century onward, managing the hermitages' operations and conducting kije. Furthermore, the extant ritual records, yŏngdang(portrait halls), and portraits in these hermitages prove that the portraits functioned as the center of temple operations.
The Kimnyongsa portraits were produced by Sin'gyŏm, Suyŏn, Chau and Ŭngsang who belonged to the sabulsan hwap'a(Sabulsan painting school) and the hwansŏnggye sŭngnyŏ munjung. Among them, Sin'gyŏm demonstrated a highly independent painting style that distinguished his work from contemporary portraits. Intriguingly, the standardized portrait style that prevailed across Kyŏngsang Province in the 19th century only appeared at Kimnyongsa after Sin'gyŏm’s active period. Following his career, Kimnyongsa’s portraits increasingly conformed to the formulaic styles of other temples.

미술사학연구.title_kr: 고려 후기 청자에 표기된 명문의 유형별 성격과 기능 구분
미술사학연구.title_en: Characteristics and Functional Classification of Different Types of Inscriptions on Late Goryeo Celadon
미술사학연구.abstract_kr:
이 논문에서는 고려 후기 명문청자를 기관명 · 의례명 · 간지명상감청자로 구분한 후, 이들 그릇의 출토 양상과 명문의 내용을 바탕으로 명문의 표시 목적과 기능을 파악하고자 하였다.
기관 · 의례명상감청자는 13세기 후반부터 14세기까지 장기간 제작되어 간지명상감청자와 공존하였던 것으로 판단된다. 또한 기관 · 의례명상감청자는 관사 및 조직, 의례 대상 등 그릇의 사용처를 구체적으로 표시하여소비처로의 납입 이후에도 명문의 기능이 유효하였다. 반면 간지 명문은 제작 연도를 표기하여 해당 기간에 공납된 그릇의 수량을 관리하는 기능을 수행하였던 것으로 보아, 왕실 납입 과정에서까지 실효성이 있었던 것으로보인다.
고려 후기 명문청자는 시기적 선후관계에 따라 변화한 것이 아니라 서로 다른 기능을 지닌 명문이 동시기에병존하였다. 나아가 이들 명문청자는 정기적인 수취를 위한 방안이라기 보다, 필요한 시점에 따라 생산 및 납입을 위한 임기응변적 성격의 결과물일 것으로 추정된다.
미술사학연구.abstract_en:
This study classifies late Goryeo period celadon with inscriptions into three types: Inlaid celadon with inscription of institution name, inlaid celadon with inscription of ritual name, and Inlaid celadon with inscription of sexagenary cycle.
By comprehensively examining their formal characteristics, excavation contexts, and inscriptional contents, this study investigates the purpose and function of these inscriptions.
Inlaid celadon with inscription of institution or ritual name is considered to have been produced over an extended period of time from the late thirteenth to the fourteenth century, coexisting with inlaid celadon with inscription of sexagenary cycle. Furthermore, the inscriptions on Inlaid celadon with inscription of institution or ritual name explicitly designated the intended institutions, ritual spaces, and other places of use, and thus continued to function even after the vessels had been delivered to their destinations. In contrast, the inscriptions on Inlaid celadon with inscription of sexagenary cycle, which recorded the year of production, are understood to have functioned primarily as a means of managing the quantity of vessels offered as tribute during a given production year, indicating that their practical function ceased with the delivery of the vessels to the royal court.
The results suggest that late Goryeo inscribed celadon did not develop through a chronological transition from one inscription type to another. Rather, different inscription types with distinct functions coexisted contemporaneously.
Furthermore, these inscribed celadons may be interpreted not as products of a regular tribute collection system but as ad hoc products manufactured and delivered in response to specific needs.

미술사학연구.title_kr: 이응노 조형세계의 횡적 다원성과 도자: 회화 · 부조 · 조각 간 조형적 연속성 연구
미술사학연구.title_en: Lee Ŭng-no Ceramics as Lateral Plurality: A Study on Formal Continuity across Painting, Relief, and Sculpture
미술사학연구.abstract_kr:
본 논문은 이응노의 도자작업을 회화, 꼴라주, 부조, 조각을 가로지르는 ‘횡적 다원성’의 관점에서 고찰한다.
이응노의 도자작업은 회화적 도상의 단순한 전이가 아니라, 문자추상, 촉각적 표면, 군상이라는 핵심 조형 원리가 점토의 가소성, 소성에 따른 수축과 변형, 유약의 유동 등 도자 고유의 물질적 조건과 결합하며 새롭게 변주된결과이다. 본 연구는 1959년 《카셀 도큐멘타 Ⅱ》 체험과 꼴라주의 시작, 1964년 김윤신과의 교류를 통한 입체조형으로의 진입, 1967년 세브르 국립도자제작소와의 협업을 도자작업 형성의 주요 계기로 살핀다. 이어 도자작품을 회화 · 부조 · 목조각과 비교 분석함으로써, 이응노의 조형세계가 매체별 단절이 아닌 동일한 조형적 사유의 물질적 재배치 속에서 전개되었음을 밝힌다. 특히 도자 매체에서는 붓의 매개 없이 작가의 손이 점토에 직접각인됨으로써, 신체적 행위와 물질이 가장 직접적으로 결합되는 지점이 형성된다는 점에 주목한다. 이를 통해본 논문은 이응노 도자작업의 미술사적 위치를 재정립하고, 그의 예술을 양식적 시기 구분이 아닌 매체 횡단적관점에서 재해석할 가능성을 제시한다.
미술사학연구.abstract_en:
Yi Ŭng-no is one of the most prominent Korean artists of the twentieth century. After settling in Paris in 1958, he developed a multifaceted practice encompassing ink painting, collage, relief, sculpture, and ceramics. Despite a growing body of scholarship on his pictorial and calligraphic practices, his ceramic oeuvre has received comparatively little sustained attention. This study examines Yi's ceramic work through the lens of what it terms "lateral pluralism" (hoengjŏk tawŏnsŏng), a framework that foregrounds the transmedial continuity of his formal principles across different material substrates rather than treating each medium as an isolated category.
The article identifies three pivotal junctures in the formation of Yi's ceramic practice: his encounter with international postwar art at documenta II in Kassel in 1959, which catalyzed his turn to collage and material experimentation; his exchange with the Argentine-Korean sculptor Kim Yun-sin beginning in 1964, which facilitated his entry into three-dimensional form; and his 1967 collaboration with the Manufacture nationale de Sèvres, which marked his first systematic engagement with the ceramic medium. These episodes are examined as cumulative stages through which Yi's pictorial and calligraphic logic was progressively extended into volumetric and tactile registers.
The core of the study undertakes a comparative analysis of Yi's ceramics alongside his paintings, reliefs, and wood sculptures, organized around three axes of formal inquiry: lettrist abstraction (munja ch'usang), the tactile treatment of surfaces, and the dimensional transformation of figural groups (kunsang). In each case, the analysis demonstrates that Yi's ceramic works are not simple transfers of pictorial imagery onto clay but rather material reconfigurations: the plasticity of clay, the shrinkage and warping induced by firing, and the fluid unpredictability of glazes imposed conditions fundamentally different from those of ink on paper, compelling the artist to negotiate between established formal intentions and the resistant logic of the ceramic medium. The study further highlights that in ceramic work, the artist's hand is imprinted directly onto material without the mediation of a brush, making ceramics the site where bodily action and substance converge most immediately in Yi's oeuvre.
The article further situates Yi's ceramics in relation to contemporaneous developments in sculptural ceramics, distinguishing his approach—characterized as a painter's transmedial projection of an existing formal system onto a new material—from the strategies of artists such as Peter Voulkos and the Sōdeisha group, whose innovations emerged from within the internal logic of the ceramic tradition itself. By positioning Yi's ceramic practice as an integral dimension of his broader formal world rather than a peripheral experiment, this study seeks to redefine its art-historical significance and to propose a transmedial, rather than strictly periodized, interpretation of his art.
The question of collaborative labor in Yi's ceramic production—involving his nephew Yi Kang-se and the ceramicists Jacky Perrin and Martin Perrin—is also addressed, though the lack of detailed archival records necessitates caution; the specific roles and chronological involvement of these collaborators remain to be clarified through future oral-history interviews and archival research. In doing so, this study illuminates a neglected dimension of Yi Ŭng-no's art while charting directions for subsequent scholarship.
